alt.en: A blue globe at the left sends a dashed orange line carrying two small packets to a large blue-tinted sheet marked with wave lines at the center. A dotted blue line with an arrow runs from the sheet to a gray camera at the right.
alt.zh: 左侧蓝色地球仪引出一条带两个小数据块的橙色虚线，通向中央印有波纹的大张蓝色纸页；一条带箭头的蓝色点线从纸页通向右侧的灰色相机。

caption.en: Illustration: a model shared around the world produces text carrying a watermark, and a verifier reads that text for an ownership response. It is not a tested deployment: it does not depict SAME or its models, and it does not show that the watermark survives fine-tuning.
caption.zh: 示意图：一个在全球流传的模型生成带水印的文本，验证者读取这些文本，查看其中的所有权回应。图中并非经过测试的部署，不代表 SAME 或其模型，也不表明水印能在微调后保留。
